retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome photographic collage featuring motion blur and layered translucent geometric overlays with elegant serif typography.
excludeWhen: clean minimalist digital vector art is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, desaturated composition featuring three male figures in a gritty interior, characterized by a central motion-blurred element and a top-aligned collage strip containing stylized serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure in sharp focus against a radial motion blur
Top-weighted horizontal collage strip containing all typography
High-contrast black and white tonal range with a single muted accent color
Triangular arrangement of subjects creating depth
coreInvariants: Translucent rectangular overlay at the top edge
Visible motion blur or long-exposure streaking

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures distributed across the midground; central figure is largest and most detailed.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the bright motion blur streak in the lower right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left logo, down the central figure, and follow the motion blur to the right-hand figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense and cluttered interior background, with negative space provided by the flat collage strip at the top.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and charcoal grays in the photographic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright whites and highlights in the motion blur and skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted terracotta or brick red for secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between shadows and highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Italicized lowercase for the primary brand
Extended horizontal bars on specific characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'a' and 'h' are connected by a stylized hyphen that mimics a brush stroke or underline.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large bold italicized serif paired with small, light, upright serif in a contrasting color.
graphicDevices: Torn edge effect on the bottom of the top strip

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif structure and classic feel.
Provides the sharp terminals and elegant curves seen in the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of three men in a 1980s interior, featuring a prominent radial motion blur effect in the foreground and a translucent gray rectangular strip across the top 20% of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold italicized serif text in dark gray on the left side of the top strip, and small red serif text to its right. Add a subtle hand-drawn horizontal line through the primary text.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text lowercase and italicized?
Is there a clear motion blur effect?
Is the color palette strictly monochrome with one accent?

adjustableVariables: Opacity of the top collage strip
Number of figures in the background
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific band names or album titles
Do not replicate the exact faces of the original artists
Ensure the 'torn' edge of the overlay is unique
postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of the top-aligned overlay
Ensure motion blur does not obscure the main subject's face
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome photography + motion blur + top-aligned translucent collage strip + high-contrast serif typography.
